name: claude-flow
description: Private marketplace of SDD/Jira/Python workflow plugins.

plugins.name: skills
plugins.description: Cross-cutting, language-agnostic skills reused across plugins.

plugins.name: python-suite
plugins.description: Reusable Python/DDD/FastAPI/SQLAlchemy agents and skills, each independently usable. No Jira coupling.

plugins.name: jira-dev-workflow
plugins.description: End-to-end Jira ticket workflow agent bundle.

plugins.name: latex-tools
plugins.description: Document-agnostic LaTeX authoring, structured Markdown-to-LaTeX generation, and verified PDF export.

plugins.name: obsidian-vault
plugins.description: One shared Obsidian vault with a folder per repository: conventions skill, vault-reader and vault-writer agents, and an opt-in hook that asks for a vault update after git push.

plugins.name: playwright-tools
plugins.description: Playwright Test (TypeScript/JavaScript) agents and skills for frontend end-to-end testing: write, review, and debug specs.

plugins.name: frontend-tools
plugins.description: React and feature-based frontend development; depends on typescript-suite for language conventions.

plugins.name: typescript-suite
plugins.description: Framework-independent TypeScript conventions, clean code, testing, implementation, and review.

plugins.name: omarchy-tools
plugins.description: Hyprland on Omarchy: live inspection, binding conflict checks, and config validation. Depends on nothing; works best next to the built-in omarchy skill.
